"'''I Like the Way (The Kissing Game)'''" is a song recorded by American R&B group [[Hi-Five]] on their debut album, ''[[Hi-Five (album)|Hi-Five]]'' (1990). The song was written by [[Teddy Riley (producer)|Teddy Riley]], [[Bernard Belle]] and [[Dave Way]], and released as the album's second [[Single (music)|single]] on January 2, 1991, by the [[Jive Records|Jive]] label. 

It became a number 1 [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] [[pop music|pop song]] and was certified Gold by the [[Recording Industry Association of America]] (RIAA) on May 10, 1991.<ref>[https://www.riaa.com/gold-platinum/?tab_active=default-award&ar=HI-FIVE&ti=I+LIKE+THE+WAY RIAA - Hi-Five - I Like The Way]</ref>

"I Like the Way (The Kissing Game)" is a song recorded by American R&B group Hi-Five on their debut album, Hi-Five (1990). The song was written by Teddy Riley, Bernard Belle and Dave Way, and released as the album's second single on January 2, 1991, by the Jive label. 

It became a number 1 Billboard Hot 100 pop song and was certified Gold by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) on May 10, 1991.

sections.heading: Chart performance
sections.wikitext: In the United States, "I Like the Way" spent two weeks at number 1 on the [[Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs]] chart;<ref>{{cite book |title= Top R&B/Hip-Hop Singles: 1942-2004|last=Whitburn |first=Joel |author-link=Joel Whitburn |year=2004 |publisher=Record Research |page=254}}</ref> and one week at number 1 on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] chart.
sections.text: In the United States, "I Like the Way" spent two weeks at number 1 on the Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart; and one week at number 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart.

sections.heading: Music video
sections.wikitext: The official music video for "I Like the Way" was directed by [[Antoine Fuqua]],<ref>{{cite web |title=Hi-Five: I Like the Way (The Kissing Game) |url=https://www.imdb.com/title/tt11616306/?ref_=nm_flmg_job_1_cdt_t_73 |website=imdb.com |publisher=IMDb.com, Inc. |access-date=2025-01-06}}</ref> and the first music video appearance of Toriano Easley’s replacement, Treston Irby.
sections.text: The official music video for "I Like the Way" was directed by Antoine Fuqua, and the first music video appearance of Toriano Easley’s replacement, Treston Irby.
